source.note: Captures the Jina OutboundTransformer.TransformResponse mapping for a valid embedding response. The Go test constructs an EmbeddingResponse{Object:'list', Model:'jina-embeddings-v3', Data:[{Object:'embedding', Index:0, Embedding:{Embedding:[0.1,0.2,0.3]}}], Usage:{PromptTokens:5, TotalTokens:5}}, marshals it, and wraps it in httpclient.Response{StatusCode:200, Body:<marshaled>, Request:{APIFormat:'jina_embedding'}}. It then asserts the resulting llm.Response has Embedding.Object=='list', Model=='jina-embeddings-v3', Usage.PromptTokens==5, Usage.TotalTokens==5. This is a response-only contract case: inbound_http, unified_request, selected_channel, outbound_http and client_http are null because the Go outbound response unit test does not exercise request or inbound stages.

upstream_http._comment: Source upstream httpclient.Response constructed by the Go test. The body is json.Marshal(EmbeddingResponse{...}). The Go test sets Request.APIFormat='jina_embedding' on the response (used by the transformer to dispatch). StatusCode=200 = http.StatusOK.

unified_response._comment: Extension field (NOT one of the six required sections) recording the llm.Response produced by OutboundTransformer.TransformResponse. The Go test asserts llmResp.Embedding.Object=='list', llmResp.Model=='jina-embeddings-v3', llmResp.Usage.PromptTokens==5, llmResp.Usage.TotalTokens==5. The Embedding.Data[0] survives the transform intact (the Go test does not separately byte-assert Data[0] fields beyond successful transformation).
